verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer/OAuth2 auth that lets external tools 'access, create and manipulate' notes content programmatically, and an official MCP server integration point for agents to read/write a Capacities space without using the GUI (confirmed by probe evidence of a documented MCP endpoint). This directly satisfies the headless read+write story via a vendor API and MCP path.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that write operations via API/MCP work reliably in practice, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s for openapi/swagger endpoints) that would make the API more verifiably complete.
